implementation_approach.title: Create CI/CD integration test pipeline
logic_flow: 定义触发条件: on push to main, on PR
Setup Python environment: Python 3.11
Install dependencies: pip install -r requirements.txt
Run integration tests: pytest tests/integration/ -v --cov=src --cov-report=xml
Upload coverage: codecov or coveralls
Fail on coverage drop: 要求覆盖率 ≥80%
添加 badge: README.md 显示测试状态和覆盖率

implementation_approach.title: Validate coverage and fix gaps
implementation_approach.description: Measure coverage, identify gaps, add missing tests
modification_points: 分析覆盖率缺口: 识别未覆盖的模块和函数
补充测试: 针对覆盖率低的模块添加测试
logic_flow: 运行 pytest --cov=src --cov-report=html
打开 htmlcov/index.html，查看覆盖率详情
识别覆盖率 <80% 的模块
为缺口模块添加集成测试
重复直到整体覆盖率 ≥80%
验证所有测试通过: pytest tests/integration/ -v
